opportunities.name: Knowledge graph
opportunities.description: Generate a typed graph of claims, premises, proofs, evidence, sources, contracts, versions, and workstreams from canonical repository data.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: A generated graph will make dependency and assurance boundaries inspectable without creating a second truth system.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Graph output drifts from canonical ledgers or cannot reject dangling, contradictory, or stale records.
opportunities.disposition: Build canonical-data foundation now; defer polished presentation.

opportunities.name: Proof and assurance explorer
opportunities.description: Expose exactly what each FAR-CORE claim proves and its independent-review, formalization, empirical, novelty, governance, version, and scope dimensions.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Dimension-separated assurance will prevent proof, review, provenance, and novelty status conflation.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Public proof transparency may improve trust and audit adoption.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A displayed result cannot be reproduced from the assurance ledger or drops a scope qualifier.
opportunities.disposition: Build backend ledger now; defer public site.

opportunities.name: Contract compiler
opportunities.description: Compile a future governed FAR contract language into typed behavior, factorization, collision, and reporting obligations.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Compilation could turn contract declarations into repeatable audits.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: A compiler could support assurance tooling and domain integrations.
opportunities.falsifier_test: No stable semantics can be defined without domain-specific normative choices that the compiler would conceal.
opportunities.disposition: Do not freeze syntax or semantics before W3.

opportunities.name: Contract linter
opportunities.description: Detect missing outcomes, hidden parameters, scope loss, Unknown collapse, decoder smuggling, and uncharged machinery in future contracts.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Static diagnostics could catch recurrent epistemic defects before execution.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Linting may be the lowest-friction adoption surface for audit teams.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Diagnostics require unstated domain judgments or report formally valid contracts as invalid without declared policy.
opportunities.disposition: Preserve diagnostic requirements; implement after schema freeze.

opportunities.name: Collision generator
opportunities.description: Search finite or bounded contracts for same-representation, different-behavior witnesses.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Explicit collision witnesses are decisive refutations of exact sufficiency claims.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Automated counterexamples could accelerate design and compliance reviews.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The generator reports absence as sufficiency or cannot preserve a finite witness deterministically.
opportunities.disposition: Prototype only on explicit finite domains; no universal conclusion.

opportunities.name: Observational quotient constructor
opportunities.description: Construct equivalence classes and a decoder for finite exact contracts.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Executable quotients make the minimal-information result intelligible and testable at finite scope.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Constructed classes fail behavior equality or do not factor the behavior map.
opportunities.disposition: Allow exact finite demonstrator; defer scalable algorithms.

opportunities.name: Assumption and dependency tracing
opportunities.description: Trace premises, definitions, claims, proofs, counterexamples, scopes, and downstream consumers.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Typed dependency links make silent premise strengthening and scope propagation failures detectable.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Dependency traceability could support audit and requirements use cases.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Known theorem dependencies remain absent or cycles are accepted where the dependency order must be acyclic.
opportunities.disposition: Implement as generated graph and formalization ledger.

opportunities.name: Automatic failure reports
opportunities.description: Emit typed failure, Unknown, inapplicability, obstruction, and counterexample reports with exact scope and provenance.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: First-class negative outcomes will reduce silent repair and false closure.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Auditable failure records may be valuable in regulated workflows.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The reporter collapses Unknown into absence or drops the exact failed premise.
opportunities.disposition: Preserve interface requirement; implement with W3 result schema.

opportunities.name: FAR API
opportunities.description: Expose future governed contract, audit, collision, quotient, and assurance operations through a stable API.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: A stable service interface could support multiple clients without duplicating semantics.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: An API could support enterprise integration after semantics stabilize.
opportunities.falsifier_test: API contracts force premature semantic commitments or differ from the canonical schema.
opportunities.disposition: Interfaces may be sketched; production semantics deferred.

opportunities.name: FAR MCP server
opportunities.description: Offer governed FAR tools and canonical assurance resources to MCP clients.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: MCP could make FAR audits available to model-assisted workflows while keeping GitHub authoritative.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: MCP distribution could lower integration cost.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The server becomes an authority or rewrites semantics outside versioned repository data.
opportunities.disposition: Do not build production server before W3.

opportunities.name: ChatGPT and agent integration
opportunities.description: Integrate FAR contract auditing and assurance views into ChatGPT or agent workflows through replaceable clients.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Interactive assistance may make formal audit discipline usable without granting models closure authority.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Agent integration may be a practical delivery channel.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Users infer proof or closure from model agreement or the integration cannot expose provenance and scope.
opportunities.disposition: Defer polished app; retain replaceable-client boundary.

opportunities.name: Finite Contract Playground
opportunities.description: Noncanonical finite-domain demonstrator for sufficiency, decoders, collisions, equivalence classes, quotients, and basic comparison.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: A small exact demonstrator can test whether the proved mathematics has an intelligible executable surface.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The demonstrator is mistaken for a universal engine or produces non-deterministic certificates.
opportunities.disposition: Implement only as explicitly experimental finite exact tooling.

opportunities.name: Multi-model adversarial research harness
opportunities.description: Run isolated blind reasoners, controlled cross-challenge, counterexample search, disagreement tracking, evidence freeze, and governed adjudication.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Provider-neutral isolation and immutable issue history can improve hostile review without treating votes as proof.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: A neutral adversarial harness could support high-assurance research teams.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Evidence leaks before provider calls, replay changes selected invocations, or failures disappear from history.
opportunities.disposition: Reimplement reusable machinery; do not merge stale PR #452 state.

opportunities.name: Epistemic firewalls
opportunities.description: Enforce staged allowlists, denylists, exposure receipts, and negative tests for clean-room campaigns.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Path-level enforcement will make accidental pre-unblinding contamination materially harder.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A prohibited path can enter a stage bundle or provider prompt without a validation failure.
opportunities.disposition: Implement reusable fail-closed path enforcement and negative tests.

opportunities.name: Evidence-freeze and replay capsules
opportunities.description: Record immutable targets, sources, evaluator identity, environment, protocols, outputs, timestamps, adjudication, and artifact hashes.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Self-contained capsules will preserve consequential research evidence and bounded replayability.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Hashes, target identity, protocol, or failures cannot be verified from the capsule.
opportunities.disposition: Implement now with explicit nondeterminism limitation.

opportunities.name: Zotero-backed citation control
opportunities.description: Use stable citation keys and bibliographic identities while GitHub governs claim-to-source and prior-art relationships.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Separating bibliography management from claim authority will improve citation stability without outsourcing governance.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Duplicate identities, dangling citation keys, or citations silently upgrade theorem or novelty status.
opportunities.disposition: Establish repository side now; Zotero Desktop remains optional.

opportunities.name: Plugin orchestration
opportunities.description: Route replaceable research, bibliography, computation, proof, and publication tools through explicit authority boundaries.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Explicit orchestration can combine tools without authority leakage.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A plugin result changes canonical state without governed repository evidence.
opportunities.disposition: Capture interfaces; defer production orchestration.

opportunities.name: Automated prior-art search
opportunities.description: Run reproducible multi-source queries, deduplicate results, record negative searches, and map candidates to exact claims.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Reproducible search logs can improve literature coverage while preserving novelty uncertainty.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Search absence is reported as novelty or source relevance is inferred without claim-level adjudication.
opportunities.disposition: Design after citation registry; no novelty automation claim.

opportunities.name: Domain contract library
opportunities.description: Curate independently motivated contracts for named reasoning and audit domains.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Versioned domain contracts can make applications comparable without universalizing one objective.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Reusable regulated-domain contracts may support adoption.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Contracts are project-invented without independent domain justification or lose relevant outcomes.
opportunities.disposition: Explicitly defer implementation to W4.

opportunities.name: AI memory and RAG sufficiency audit
opportunities.description: Audit whether retrieval or memory representations preserve behavior relevant to declared agent tasks.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Collision audits may expose task-relevant information loss in memory and RAG systems.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Memory sufficiency audits may be commercially useful for agent reliability.
opportunities.falsifier_test: No independently motivated task contract separates retrieval quality from downstream model behavior.
opportunities.disposition: Research application only after W3/W4; no product claim.

opportunities.name: Multi-agent handoff audit
opportunities.description: Test whether agent-to-agent handoff artifacts preserve consequence-affecting state, assumptions, Unknowns, and provenance.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Factorization and collision checks may reveal lossy handoffs.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Handoff assurance may support complex agent workflows.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The proposed contract cannot distinguish handoff loss from reasoner variation.
opportunities.disposition: Preserve as W4/W6 application candidate.

opportunities.name: Argument translation
opportunities.description: Compare argument representations under declared semantics, burdens, defeat, and provenance contracts.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Contract-relative comparison may identify when translations preserve or collapse substantive argument structure.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A translation evaluation relies on one unstated argumentation semantics.
opportunities.disposition: Defer domain semantics to W4.

opportunities.name: Debate and falsification mode
opportunities.description: Orchestrate explicit strongest-objection, counterexample, mutation, and falsifier passes against frozen claims.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Structured challenge may expose defects that cooperative synthesis misses.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Challenge lanes share hidden state before blind issue extraction or adjudication becomes a vote.
opportunities.disposition: Implement as harness mode, not proof authority.

opportunities.name: Literature audit
opportunities.description: Map sources to exact claims, support/dispute/context roles, prior-art relationships, and unresolved novelty limits.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Claim-level evidence mapping will make literature use auditable.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A source is cited without bibliographic identity or relationship to a specific claim/artifact.
opportunities.disposition: Create citation-control foundation now; full audit later.

opportunities.name: Compliance and audit applications
opportunities.description: Apply contract, evidence, provenance, and failure-boundary methods to scoped compliance workflows.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: FAR may help distinguish recorded conformance from evidence of substantive adequacy.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Regulated audit workflows are a plausible market if utility is empirically demonstrated.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Domain rules cannot be represented without unauthorized legal or normative inference.
opportunities.disposition: Research only; no compliance claim before domain evidence.

opportunities.name: Requirements-engineering applications
opportunities.description: Audit whether specifications, implementations, tests, and handoffs preserve declared requirements behavior.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Collision and traceability methods may expose requirements loss across artifacts.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Requirements traceability may be a practical enterprise application.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Declared tests do not capture material stakeholder requirements or tooling confuses test coverage with sufficiency.
opportunities.disposition: Retain as domain-contract candidate.

opportunities.name: Visualization
opportunities.description: Render quotient classes, collision witnesses, dependency graphs, assurance dimensions, and disagreement histories from generated data.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Visual explanations could make exact contract-relative results easier to inspect.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Visual labels lose scope or imply a total order across incomparable assurance dimensions.
opportunities.disposition: Defer polished visualization; generate data first.

opportunities.name: Research dashboard
opportunities.description: Display canonical workstream state, open questions, opportunities, campaigns, and assurance without manual duplication.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: A generated dashboard could reduce navigation cost and stale status surfaces.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Dashboard values cannot be traced to canonical machine data or become a competing authority.
opportunities.disposition: Backend generation now; UI later.

opportunities.name: Automatic current-state generation
opportunities.description: Derive current workstream, assurance, and generated views from canonical machine records and fail CI on drift.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Single-source generation will prevent stale W1-open and cross-surface status contradictions.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A governed machine-state change passes CI while current status and generated views disagree.
opportunities.disposition: Extend existing consistency machinery and generators.

opportunities.name: Branch and PR hygiene automation
opportunities.description: Inventory refs and PRs, detect unique commits, classify evidence value, and recommend non-destructive cleanup.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Evidence-aware classification can reduce residue without deleting unique research history.
opportunities.falsifier_test: The tool recommends deletion without proving absence of unique commits/evidence.
opportunities.disposition: Implement inventory and dry-run only; destructive pruning unauthorized.

opportunities.name: Publication strategy
opportunities.description: Prepare scoped mathematical, methodology, mechanization, and empirical publications with explicit prior-art and novelty limits.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Separating result types may support accurate peer review and dissemination.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A publication draft asserts novelty, universality, or machine proof beyond the ledgers.
opportunities.disposition: Prepare only after assurance state stabilizes.

opportunities.name: Commercialization research
opportunities.description: Investigate users, pains, willingness to pay, delivery surfaces, and evidence requirements without treating mathematical validity as product demand.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Separate market evidence can test whether scoped FAR tooling has practical value.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Audit, requirements, and agent-memory workflows may contain viable initial markets.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Independent interviews or trials show no material workflow improvement or willingness to adopt.
opportunities.disposition: Research only after W3/W4 semantics and W6 evidence.

opportunities.name: Integrated-system novelty investigation
opportunities.description: Investigate whether the integrated contract-freezing, factorization, collision, provenance, Unknown, and failure-boundary discipline has prior synthesis.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: The integration may be a defensible contribution even though quotient and factorization mathematics are prior art.
opportunities.falsifier_test: A prior independently motivated system reconstructs the integrated discipline at the stated scope.
opportunities.disposition: Novelty unresolved; no priority claim.

opportunities.name: Approximate and cost-sensitive FAR
opportunities.description: Extend exact adequacy with declared metrics, losses, tolerances, algorithms, and cost preorders.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Declared approximation and cost could make FAR usable where exact quotients are impractical.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Approximate audits may be required for production-scale adoption.
opportunities.falsifier_test: No domain-independent metric or cost order is justified; any useful result remains explicitly contract-specific.
opportunities.disposition: Explicitly defer production engine to W5.

opportunities.name: Empirical W6 benchmark system
opportunities.description: Preregister and run studies testing whether FAR audit discipline catches material loss or improves decision quality.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Controlled empirical evidence can determine whether the method has utility beyond mathematical correctness.
opportunities.commercial_hypothesis: Positive externally replicated utility evidence would support product investment.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Preregistered benchmarks show no improvement, harmful overhead, or non-replicating effects.
opportunities.disposition: Infrastructure now; study execution remains W6.

opportunities.name: Universal primitive architecture
opportunities.description: Claim that one globally necessary and minimal primitive vocabulary underlies all reasoning.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Historical hypothesis only; no surviving value hypothesis as a current program direction.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Already blocked as a contract-free inference by vocabulary noninvariance and lack of global lower bounds; reopening requires a new reproducible contradiction to the governed theory.
opportunities.disposition: SUPERSEDED; must not return through product or formalization language.

opportunities.name: Universal fixed operator basis
opportunities.description: Claim that reasoning has a representation-independent fixed count of primitive operators.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Historical hypothesis only.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Tagged combination and splitting already defeat representation-independent operator count under the admitted regime.
opportunities.disposition: REJECTED at contract-free scope; workflow verbs may remain labels only.

opportunities.name: Native common structure from encoding capacity
opportunities.description: Infer native, explanatory, necessary, or minimal common structure merely because all targets can be encoded in one host.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: No valid current value hypothesis.
opportunities.falsifier_test: FAR-CORE-006 transport constructions show capacity while all source structure can reside in the encoder/decoder.
opportunities.disposition: REJECTED; encoding demonstrations must charge machinery and remain capacity claims.

opportunities.name: Finite panel as universal proof
opportunities.description: Promote success on a finite system panel to an open-domain universality theorem.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: No valid current value hypothesis.
opportunities.falsifier_test: FAR-CORE-009 supplies an off-panel two-completion countermodel absent an independent coverage premise.
opportunities.disposition: REJECTED; finite evidence remains bounded empirical or executable evidence.

opportunities.name: Omega as independent primitive
opportunities.description: Treat canonical FARA Omega as an independent semantic cause or irreducible primitive.
opportunities.value_hypothesis: Materialization remains operationally useful, but primitive status has no surviving basis.
opportunities.falsifier_test: Canonical Omega is Rep(Class_kappa(z)); any independent divergence reveals hidden input, changed calculus, corruption, or extra information.
opportunities.disposition: SUPERSEDED as primitive; retain only cache, audit, interface, or provenance roles.
